sjh9714-skill-receipts-repro-first.description: Use when fixing a reported bug — reproduce it with a failing test before touching the code, then make the minimal fix at the true cause; never patch the symptom or files unrelated to the bug.

sjh9714-skill-receipts-underkill.description: Use when writing or modifying code — implementing features, refactoring, or fixing bugs — to prevent over-engineering: unrequested abstractions, options, config, dependencies, and defensive code. Build exactly what was asked, nothing more.
